verdict.rationale: Maritime's SDK/CLI/API expose idempotent `provision`, scoped API keys, webhooks for lifecycle state, and an explicit example (docs-16) of an agent (e.g. Claude Code) autonomously provisioning and recreating workloads via API/CLI without a human — supporting most of the 'agent runs the loop' story. However there's no explicit documentation of a teardown/delete endpoint or of an agent reading execution/code-output results (only state-change webhooks), so the full provision→execute→read→teardown loop isn't fully evidenced end-to-end. missing for 10: explicit teardown/delete API call, explicit mechanism for reading code-execution output/results, independent corroboration of full autonomous loop.
